label: Weekend of Nov 13–15
note: Ranks are MHR’s Nov 11 ratings and move live as results come in. Game times are local to the rink. Many rinks stream on LiveBarn.

summary: Challenger Cup after Saturday morning: Toronto Jr Canadiens (CAN) are 3-0 with three shutouts (3-0 Top Gun, 6-0 Windy City, 6-0 St. Louis). Little Caesars (#3, 97.66) are 3-0 and Nashville (#8, 96.52) is 3-0. Team Illinois (#6, 97.02) is 3-0 with two shutouts.

Fox Motors (#29) is 2-0 and leads Upper Canada College (CAN) 2-1 right now. Huron-Perth (CAN) bounced back from a loss to Team Illinois with wins over NJ Colonials and Cleveland. Chatham-Kent (CAN) is 2-1 after LC beat them 4-1.

Top Gun (#12, 96.22) lost its first two (0-3 Toronto, 3-5 St. Louis) before beating Biggby 5-2. Masters Academy (#26) is 1-1-1. Chicago Mission (#5, 97.06) hasn't played; it hosts the Reapers today at 12:30.

Players to watch: Toronto's Tristan Reynolds leads the event with 9 points (7 goals) in three games. Pittsburgh's Theo Lessard (6 goals) and Tristan Leduc (7 assists) have 13 points between them in two games. Tap any game below for every goal, assist and penalty.

summary: Little Caesars (#8, 93.08) are hosting a three-team round robin in Detroit with Bishop Kearney Selects (#2, 95.55) and Shattuck St Mary's (#4, 94.33). Each pair plays twice.
So far: Bishop Kearney won 3-1 at LC on Thursday. On Friday Shattuck beat Bishop Kearney 6-2 (an upset over the #2 team), and LC answered with a 5-1 win over Shattuck.
Chicago Reapers (#5, 93.53) and Chicago Mission (#6, 93.46) play twice: Saturday 2:40 PM at Elk Grove and Sunday 1:30 PM at Mount Prospect.

Also this weekend: St. Louis Blues (#12, 92.19), Philadelphia Jr Flyers (#17, 91.45), North Jersey Avalanche (#21, 90.98) and Victory Honda (#22, 90.59) are at a showcase at Arctic Ice Arena. Mount St Charles (#3, 95.00) plays PAL Jr Islanders three times in league play, and Woodbridge (#9, 92.78) plays South Kent School twice. Penguins Elite (#1, 96.16) have no games listed.
